```{r load-libraries}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)

out_name = glue("bcx_mvp_results_{date}", date=lubridate::today())
```

# Read in data

## Read in BCX file

```{r}
bcx = read_excel("TOUSE_TableS3_BCX3sentinels_5Aug2026.xlsx", skip=2) %>%
    mutate(assoc_id=glue("{Phenotype}_{rsid}")) %>%
    select(assoc_id, everything())
head(bcx)
```

## Read in trait mapping file

```{r}
mapping = read_tsv("mapping.tsv")
mapping
```

## Requested variants

These are the variants that were extracted from MVP results files.
In some cases, a variant was not present in the results file for a trait, likely due to allele frequency.

```{r}
requested_variants = tibble(
    rsid=readLines("variants.txt")
)
requested_variants %>% dim()
```

## Extracted summary statistics

```{r, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE}
files = list.files("results", recursive=T)
col_types = cols(
    "SNP_ID"=col_character(),
    "chrom"=col_character(),
    "pos"=col_integer(),
    "ref"=col_character(),
    "alt"=col_character(),
    "ea"=col_character(),
    "af"=col_double(),
    "num_samples"=col_integer(),
    "beta"=col_double(),
    "sebeta"=col_double(),
    "case_af"=col_double(),
    "num_cases"=col_integer(),
    "control_af"=col_double(),
    "num_controls"=col_integer(),
    "or"=col_double(),
    "ci"=col_character(),
    "pval"=col_double(),
    "r2"=col_double(),
    "q_pval"=col_double(),
    "i2"=col_double(),
    "direction"=col_character()
)

regex_file = "MVP_R4.1000G_AGR\\.(.+?)\\.(.+?)\\.GIA.dbGaP.txt.gz.txt"

res_list = list()
for (i in seq_along(mapping$trait_mvp)) {
    trait_files = files[str_detect(files, mapping$trait_mvp[i])]
    tmp = lapply(file.path("results", trait_files), read_tsv, show_col_types=F, col_types=col_types, na="NA") %>%
        setNames(trait_files) %>%
        bind_rows(.id="file") %>%
        separate_wider_delim(file, delim="/", names=c("batch", "file")) %>%
        mutate(
            tmp=str_replace(file, "MVP_R4.1000G_AGR\\.", ""),
            tmp=str_replace(tmp, "\\.GIA.dbGaP.txt.gz.txt", ""),
            trait_bcx = mapping$trait_bcx[i],
            assoc_id = glue("{trait_bcx}_{SNP_ID}")
    ) %>%
    filter(assoc_id %in% bcx$assoc_id) %>%
    separate_wider_delim(tmp, delim=".", names=c("trait_mvp", "population")) %>%
    mutate(trait_category=str_replace(batch, "_batch.+", ""))
    res_list[[i]] = tmp
}

results = res_list %>% bind_rows() %>%
    select(-assoc_id)
```

Summarize the number of traits for a given population and variant:

```{r}
tmp = results %>%
    group_by(SNP_ID, population) %>%
    summarise(
        n_traits=n(),
        n_signif=sum(pval < 5e-8)
    )
tmp %>% kable() %>% collapse_rows(columns = 1:2, valign = "top") %>% kable_styling(full_width=F)
```

# Plots

## Define data and functions for later use

```{r}
x = results %>%
    filter() %>%
    mutate(
        label=ifelse(pval < 1e-8, trait_mvp, "")
    ) %>%
    arrange(trait_category, trait_mvp) %>%
    mutate(plot_x=ordered(trait_mvp, levels=trait_mvp[!duplicated(trait_mvp)]))

plot_population <- function(data, population) {
    plot_data = data %>% filter(population==!!population)
    p = ggplot(plot_data, aes(x=trait_mvp, y=-log10(pval))) +
        geom_point(aes(color=trait_category), size=0.5)  +
        facet_grid(rows=vars(SNP_ID), cols=vars(trait_category), scales="free") +
        theme_bw() +
        #theme_classic() +
        theme(
            legend.position="top",
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x=element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x=element_blank()
        )
    p
}

plot_snp <- function(data, snp) {
    plot_data = data %>% filter(SNP_ID==!!snp)
    p = ggplot(plot_data, aes(x=trait_mvp, y=-log10(pval))) +
        geom_point(aes(color=population), size=0.5)  +
        facet_grid(rows=vars(population), cols=vars(trait_category), scales="free") +
        theme_bw() +
        #theme_classic() +
        theme(
            legend.position="top",
            #panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            #panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x=element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x=element_blank()
        )
    p
}
```

# Save combined file

```{r}
dir.create(out_name)
```

## Data file

```{r}
out = results %>%
    select(
        trait_category,
        trait_bcx,
        trait_mvp,
        SNP_ID,
        population,
        everything()
    ) %>%
    select(
        -batch,
        -file,
        -alt
    ) %>%
    rename(
        other_allele=ref,
        effect_allele=ea,
        allele_frequency=af,
    )
out %>%
    write_tsv(file=glue("{out_name}/{out_name}.txt.gz", ))
```

## Data dictionary

```{r}
tmp = c(
    trait_category = "Category of trait (determined using filename from MVP)",
    trait_mvp = "Name of trait from MVP",
    trait_bcx = "Name of trait from BCX",
    SNP_ID = "rsID that results are for",
    chrom = "Chromosome of variant",
    pos = "Basepair position of variant",
    other_allele = "Other allele",
    effect_allele = "Effect/tested allele",
    allele_frequency = "Frequency of effect_allele in tested samples",
    num_samples = "Number of samples included in analysis for this variant and trait",
    beta = "Effect size (quantitative traits only)",
    sebeta = "Standard error of effect size (quantitative traits only)",
    pval = "p-value",
    r2 = "Percent variance explained by SNP?",
    q_pval = "(meta analysis only) Cochran's heterogeneity statistic's p-value",
    i2 = "(meta analysis only) Heterogeneity index I2 by Higgins et al 2003",
    direction = "(meta analysis only) Direction of effects from contributing populations",
    case_af = "(binary traits only) effect allele frequency in cases",
    num_cases = "(binary traits only) number of cases",
    control_af = "(binary traits only) effect allele frequency of controls",
    num_controls = "(binary traits only) number of controls",
    or = "(binary traits only) Odds ratio",
    ci = "(binary traits only) Confidence intervals on odds ratio",
    population = "Sample population (EUR, AFR, AMR) or meta-analysis (META)"
)
stopifnot(all(names(out) %in% names(tmp)))
tmp = tmp[names(out)]
stopifnot(setequal(names(tmp), names(out)))
dd = tmp[names(out)] %>%
    enframe(name="variable", value="description")
stopifnot(all.equal(dd$variable, names(out)))

write_tsv(dd, file=glue("{out_name}/{out_name}_dd.tsv", date=lubridate::today()))
```

## Tar the output
